about: Step 06 Chrome probes. Chrome 155.0.8059.85 (local macOS 27.0.1 arm64, 2026-10-21, INDICATIVE) printed each probe through fidelity/lib/chrome-reference.mjs (print media, bundled Liberation @font-face aliases, page.pdf A4 + preferCSSPageSize + printBackground). vellora rendered each with renderPdf(html, undefined, { strict: true }): 'before' = the step-05 build (the worktree at 2fd9576 before the change), 'after' = c9fe9f5. Words: PyMuPDF 1.28.2 rawdict character origins (x = pen x of the first glyph, baseline = origin y, PDF pt, top-left origin), split on white space; a {page, pageSize} row closes each page. Chrome loads an @font-face only when an element uses it: in probes.json the margin-box faces are not used by the body, so Chrome printed those boxes in its system fallback (Times-Roman/Helvetica) or not at all (declared_sans_8pt); probes2.json repeats them with the faces loaded by body spans.
